strings.name: Mark Zuckerberg
strings.summary: Zuckerberg created Facebook with partners while studying at Harvard, developing a campus social website into a global platform. He brought businesses including Instagram and WhatsApp into the same corporate group. In 2021, he announced the company’s renaming as Meta and investment in virtual and augmented reality. User privacy, platform power and content governance have also remained major sources of controversy throughout his career.
strings.coverageNote: Selected life events and corporate turning points from 1984 to 2021. Later changes to products, litigation and management roles are outside this edition’s coverage.
strings.facts.fact-01.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-01.value: White Plains, New York, United States
strings.facts.fact-02.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-02.value: Attended Harvard University, then left to build his company
strings.facts.fact-03.label: Associated organizations
strings.highlights.highlight-01.title: Building a global social platform
strings.highlights.highlight-01.text: Co-founded Facebook with partners in 2004, helping bring online social networking to a mass audience.
strings.highlights.highlight-02.title: Expanding a mobile product portfolio
strings.highlights.highlight-02.text: Acquired Instagram and WhatsApp, adding photo sharing and instant messaging to the business.
strings.highlights.highlight-03.title: Funding science and philanthropy
strings.highlights.highlight-03.text: Founded the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative with Priscilla Chan in 2015 to support scientific research and social causes.
strings.timeline.event-01.title: Company renamed Meta
strings.timeline.event-01.text: Announced Meta as the umbrella for its applications and technologies, with the metaverse and immersive social experiences as development priorities.
strings.timeline.event-02.title: Reaches a privacy settlement
strings.timeline.event-02.text: Facebook agreed to pay a US$5 billion civil penalty and accept new privacy oversight and executive-accountability requirements.
strings.timeline.event-03.title: Co-founds CZI
strings.timeline.event-03.text: Established the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative with Priscilla Chan, investing in disease research, education and community projects.
strings.timeline.event-04.title: Announces the WhatsApp acquisition
strings.timeline.event-04.text: Facebook announced its acquisition of the messaging service WhatsApp, further expanding its mobile communications business.
strings.timeline.event-05.title: Facebook goes public
strings.timeline.event-05.text: The company’s initial public offering brought a dorm-room venture into public capital markets.
strings.timeline.event-06.title: Announces the Instagram acquisition
strings.timeline.event-06.text: Facebook reached an agreement to acquire Instagram, expanding its presence in mobile photo sharing.
strings.timeline.event-07.title: Co-founds Facebook
strings.timeline.event-07.text: Launched the social website with partners at Harvard, then left university to focus on developing the company.
strings.timeline.event-08.title: Born in New York State
strings.timeline.event-08.text: Born in White Plains, grew up in New York State and later attended Harvard University.
